info.name: List all Projects for an Org with the given Org ID.

params.name: org_id
params.description: The ID of the org that the projects belong to.

params.name: target_id
params.description: Return projects that belong to the provided targets

params.name: target_reference
params.description: Return projects that match the provided target reference

params.name: target_file
params.description: Return projects that match the provided target file

params.name: target_runtime
params.description: Return projects that match the provided target runtime

params.name: meta_count
params.description: The collection count.

params.name: ids
params.description: Return projects that match the provided IDs.

params.name: names
params.description: Return projects that match the provided names.

params.name: names_start_with
params.description: Return projects with names starting with the specified prefix.

params.name: origins
params.description: Return projects that match the provided origins.

params.name: types
params.description: Return projects that match the provided types.

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand relationships.

params.name: meta.latest_issue_counts
params.description: Include a summary count for the issues found in the most recent scan of this project

params.name: meta.latest_dependency_total
params.description: Include the total number of dependencies found in the most recent scan of this project

params.name: cli_monitored_before
params.description: Filter projects uploaded and monitored before this date (encoded value)

params.name: cli_monitored_after
params.description: Filter projects uploaded and monitored after this date (encoded value)

params.name: importing_user_public_id
params.description: Return projects that match the provided importing user public ids.

params.name: tags
params.description: Return projects that match all the provided tags

params.name: business_criticality
params.description: Return projects that match all the provided business_criticality value

params.name: environment
params.description: Return projects that match all the provided environment values

params.name: lifecycle
params.description: Return projects that match all the provided lifecycle values

params.name: version
params.description: The requested version of the endpoint to process the request

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return the page of results immediately after this cursor

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return the page of results immediately before this cursor

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page
